cases.name: Route table shape changes
cases.prompt: I have one row per customer and columns sales_2024 and sales_2025. I need a row per customer-year for a downstream grouped summary. Which tidyverse skill should own the change and what invariant should I check?
cases.description: Choose the owning tidyverse skill and verify the table grain before reshaping.
traps: Treat a wide table as always invalid

assertions.text: Routes the shape change to tidyr
Explains that pivoting changes rows and columns
Mentions checking identifier uniqueness or row counts

cases.name: Diagnose retained grouping
cases.prompt: A grouped tibble feeds three later operations and one unexpectedly summarizes by the old groups. Diagnose the likely cause and give a safe review strategy.
cases.description: Inspect grouping metadata and control whether later operations retain or remove groups.
traps: Assume ungroup() is always required immediately

assertions.text: Identifies grouping metadata as a possible cause
Explains intentional use of .groups or ungroup()

cases.name: Investigate common-type coercion
cases.prompt: A join or bind_rows result turns Date and numeric columns into character. Explain how to investigate without blindly applying as.character() everywhere.
cases.description: Trace unexpected coercion through input prototypes and preserve meaningful column types.
traps: Treat NA and NULL as interchangeable

assertions.text: Distinguishes typed missing values from NULL
Preserves semantic types with explicit conversion
